title: Commitment-Time Mandate Scope and Freshness Verification

name.const: Commitment-Time Mandate Scope and Freshness Verification

description.const: System owners must verify the resolved action against the active mandate's scope, value ceiling, and non-revoked freshness at the point of commitment before executing any state-mutating tool or transaction.

verification-timing.description: Mandate checks must execute at the point of commitment to prevent stale-authority execution.

max-mandate-staleness-seconds.description: Maximum age in seconds of a mandate revocation/freshness check before commitment is blocked.

on-uncertain-prior-outcome.description: Required behavior when a prior execution attempt has an unknown outcome to prevent duplicate settlement.
